text_block_list.text:
After the Japanese Derby, the public could 
talk of nothing but Duramente and Satono 
Crown. However――

Duramente suffers a fracture. She must 
focus entirely on recovery... and won't 
make it in time for the Kikuka Sho or Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe.

Even so, Satono Crown believes in 
Duramente's return. The chance to defeat 
her will surely come.

Kitasan Black was crushed. She despised 
herself for having thought the Kikuka Sho 
would be an easy win just because 
Duramente wasn't there...
